items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I was one of the performers that was in it with Louis Prima and Dick Powell and Robert Montgomery and Fred Astaire, with all these people in this show.

ctx.x: Well, you did a sand dance, didn't you?

Yeah, something like that -- well, I did that for Dick Powell later on from this spot -- we were in two different spots doing this, you know. Where we had the coal there was a dance and with the piano was another dance where I did the sand dance there, see.
Was this the first time you'd done a sand dance?
